title: My Son Sold My Gallery, Gave Me A $2,800 Check. So I Voided The Sale And Took Back My Business.
description: After co-founding a framing gallery with my son using my $91K nursing pension, he forged an asset sale and handed me a $2,800 framed check. I found the original notarized agreement, voided the sale, and now he works for me in a 'Mitered Lies' shirt while every frame ships with a QR code to the judgment. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #FramedByFraud
thumb_text: HE FRAMED ME WITH A $2,800 CHECK
pinned_comment: Has your child ever betrayed your life savings like this? If you’d found your son’s forged asset sale and a framed $2,800 check, would you have sued or just walked away? Share your story in the comments.
